ctx.x: Alright, we can turn it off. Tell me about, did you ever know Buddy Bolden? Did you ever hear him?

items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: he got me this figuring and straightening

ctx.x: Tall dog cop. How old were you when you played with Buddy Bolden?
Nah, he got me this figuring and straightening. Yeah. Six weeks old, say, to him? You know, I started out young, you know.
